title: Asset Servicing & Accounting
intro: This level covers voluntary corporate actions from notice to posting (rights, tenders, exchange offers, scrip, proxy votes and claims), income and gain accounting, fund NAV, P&L explain and performance measurement. It ends with the bank-side journal entries under IFRS 9.
